meta.title: Car rental
meta.description: Find your car. Book in minutes.

whatsapp.prefill: Hi, I have a question about renting a car.

footer.tagline: Professional car rental with no hidden fees.

cookies.title: We use cookies
cookies.body: Necessary cookies make the site work. With your consent we also use cookies for statistics and marketing. You can change your choice at any time.
cookies.necessaryDescription: Required for login, booking and security. Cannot be turned off.
cookies.analyticsDescription: Helps us understand how the site is used.

home.title: Find your car. Book in minutes.
home.subtitle: The platform is under development.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page has moved or does not exist yet.

login.title: Log in
login.intro: Log in to see your bookings.
login.twoFactorIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.backupIntro: Enter one of your backup codes.
login.useAuthenticator: Use a code from the app instead

register.title: Create account
register.intro: With an account you can see and manage your bookings. You can also book without one.
register.sentBody: We have sent a link to {email}. Click the link to confirm your email and activate your account.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If there is an account for {email}, we have sent a link to reset your password. The link works for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Choose a new password for your account. You will be logged out everywhere else.
reset.doneBody: You can now log in with your new password.

verify.successBody: Your account is active and you are logged in.
verify.errorBody: The link has expired or was already used. Log in and we will send a new link to your email.

errors.emailNotVerified: Your email is not confirmed yet. We have sent a new link to your email.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact us if this is a mistake.
errors.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired.
errors.invalidToken: The link has expired or was already used.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {min} characters.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

account.title: My account
account.comingSoon: Soon you will see your bookings, payments and documents here.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.intro: The admin panel is built in the next milestones. Here you can see what your role gives access to.

security.title: Security
security.required: Your role requires two-factor authentication (2FA). Turn it on to access the admin panel.
security.disabledInfo: Two-factor authentication is off. We recommend it for all staff.
security.step2: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or 1Password) and enter the 6-digit code.
security.backupBody: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe. They are only shown now.

verify.subject: Confirm your email
verify.body: Thank you for signing up. Confirm your email to activate your account.
verify.note: The link works for 24 hours. If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your password
reset.body: We received a request to reset your password.
reset.note: The link works for 1 hour. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password has not changed.

existing.subject: You already have an account
existing.body: Someone tried to create an account with your email. You already have an account, so you can just log in. If you forgot your password, you can reset it on the login page.
existing.note: If this was not you, you can ignore this email. Your account has not changed.
